core.estimator: hybrid (gene probes if the observed capture is at least 0.6, else the EM estimate)

extended.probe_set: variant-free probe windows of all annotated transcripts (extended tier)
extended.rule: all annotated transcripts chr1-19/X, any isoform subset, <=8 genes, <=8 genome copies, variant-free at every annotated copy, >=100 nt from ends of some containing transcript, 26 nt spacing (R-k+1), core gene probes placed first
extended.estimator: ridge-NNLS, E[c_p]=sum_t n_pt lambda_t, ridge 1e-6 x max col norm^2, N_g=sum_t lambda_t*max(L_t-R+1,25)

101bp.extended: design stages rerun with probe spacing 77, read length 101, probes_s77.npz; estimator with read length 101

identity_rule: sample kept if the labelled strain has the top fit and the fit is at least 0.90 (dk.py)
scoring: core genes only; extended-tier genes are reported separately
